coverage_limits: Synthetic HTTP handler exposition and separate loopback API health verification. No combined scrape-plus-health peak, real API-server throughput, watch ingestion, network transport, or Prometheus ingestion capacity measurement.
dirty_scope: Documentation, e2e fixtures and NIM installer outside the measured source manifest.

host.provenance: Host description supplied by the coordinating validation session.

isolation: One scale process at a time after live acceptance; no concurrent build, race suite, image build, or acceptance load during measurement. The dedicated acceptance cluster remained idle; this was not an empty host.
published_log_sanitization: Startup panic stacks replace absolute workspace and toolchain paths with relative or descriptive paths; local listen address is a placeholder. Original raw output is retained outside the repository.
startup_failures: Both initial health processes exited 2 before fixture creation because the sandbox denied a loopback listener. Both were rerun with loopback access and passed. These are not health-capacity measurements.
